Changing user interface

Before joining Groww, I tried several trading platforms, but I chose Groww because I genuinely loved its user interface (UI/UX). Unfortunately, the user experience is getting worse with every unnecessary change. The sidebar has disappeared from the stock chart view, making navigation less convenient.

Please don’t turn Groww into another Facebook or Instagram. Users come to Groww to invest, analyse charts, and trade—not to experience a social-media-style interface.

The simplicity and functionality of Groww were its biggest strengths. Please bring back the sidebar in the chart view and prioritise the needs of traders and investors over unnecessary UI changes.

Don’t fix what isn’t broken. Bring back the interface that made us love Groww in the first place.

One of the most pathetic experiences I have ever had with a financial platform.

Groww looks impressive until you actually need help. The moment there is a serious issue involving your money, the so-called “customer support” becomes an endless cycle of useless automated replies, copy-pasted messages and absolutely zero accountability.

It is honestly frustrating to see a financial platform put so much effort into making the app look smooth while seemingly putting so little effort into actually helping customers when something goes wrong.

You don’t feel like a customer—you feel like a ticket number being passed around by a system that doesn’t care whether your problem gets resolved or not.

When money is involved, “please wait” and generic replies are NOT customer service.

The entire experience has been unbelievably frustrating, time-consuming and disappointing. If you expect quick resolution, proper communication and someone to actually take ownership of your issue, don’t expect much from Groww.

I seriously regret choosing this platform. A financial service should give customers confidence and peace of mind—not make them constantly worry about whether their issue will ever be resolved.

Groww needs a reality check. A good-looking app cannot compensate for terrible support and a frustrating customer experience.

I would not recommend Groww based on my experience. There are better alternatives where customers deserve to be treated like customers.

I am facing serious issues while trading on the Groww platform.

Whenever I place an order at the price currently displayed on the app, or set a specific price at which I want to buy or sell, my order is often not executed at the expected price or within the expected time.

I am also experiencing problems with stop-loss orders. Even after setting a specific stop-loss level, my position sometimes gets executed at a different price, resulting in a higher loss than I expected.

There also appears to be a delay in order execution. Even when the market reaches the price at which my order should be triggered, the order is not always executed immediately. This has caused me financial losses on multiple occasions.

I request you to investigate the following:

1. Why are my orders not being executed promptly when the market reaches my specified price?
2. Why are my stop-loss orders sometimes executed at a price different from the stop-loss level I set?
3. Is there any execution delay, slippage, liquidity issue, or other technical reason responsible for these differences?
4. Please provide the complete order execution details for the affected trades, including the order placement time, trigger time, execution time, requested price, and actual executed price.

I request a proper investigation and a clear explanation regarding these issues, as they are directly affecting my trades and causing financial losses.

Please resolve this issue at the earliest.
